summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The LSV Disciplined Value ETF (LSVD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of global equity securities considered to be exhibiting value characteristics. LSVD was launched on Dec 17, 2024 and is issued by LSV.

holdings.infoBox: LSVD is an equity ETF with a total of 136 individual holdings. The top holdings are Alphabet stock at 6.77%, NVIDIA at 6.76%, Apple at 5.76%, Amazon.com at 3.64%, and Microsoft at 3.31%.
